reason: Both identify the same location (the "7d" preset's from-date) and the same mechanism: it still computes daysAgo(7) instead of the n-1 correction (daysAgo(6)) that was applied to the other presets, and with the inclusive [from,to] window this yields an 8-day span instead of 7. The reviewer's framing (unlike 30d/90d which were fixed to n-1) is additional supporting context, not a different bug — the underlying runtime misbehavior described is identical.
